audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows gave the stage to Kled or Skill while their own whys say Akshan edges it: Level 2 ('he edges this until you hit your re-E combo'), Level 3 ('he holds the edge unless you trap him'), Levels 4-5 ('out-trading you whenever you can't pin him'), First item ('faster than your bruiser spike can answer').
audit.why: Win rate is 47.71% over 262 games and the packet levelChart reads Kled,Akshan,Akshan,Akshan,Akshan,Akshan,Kled. Akshan outranges Kled — Avengerang is 850 to Kled's 800 Bear Trap — and Heroic Swing resets the distance every 18s.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and First item flipped to Akshan in both layers, ratings dropped to 4/10. Level 1 (Akshan) and 2+ items (Kled) already matched their whys and were left alone.

audit.why: The four spikes are correctly ordered — Akshan level 1, Kled 2-3, Kled 6 with Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, Akshan late — and match the corrected chart. Only the cooldown numbers were missing.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing's 18s rank-1 cooldown and Bear Trap's 11s added to dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d so the windows are countable.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the two decisive Akshan interactions: Heroic Swing REQUIRES terrain to fire the grapple into, and Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure it hits.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it' — in open lane, away from a wall, he has no escape and Kled's all-in is free. And 'dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit' means a minion between you and him eats the whole ult, which matters enormously to a dismounted Kled on low health.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d states the terrain requirement, dontsFull[2].d turns it into positioning advice, dosFull[2].d states the minion-block on Comeuppance, dontsFull[0].d states that Comeuppance scales off your missing health at 2500 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage when it's down' with no number, and the packet counted only 1 sequencing cue.
audit.why: Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s is the longest punishable window in the matchup; Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1 and is Kled's only pin.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now on the page.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Swing needs terrain and is 18s at rank 1 — engage him in open lane, off the walls.

edits.before: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Comeuppance stops on the first minion hit — stand behind the wave.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Comeuppance scales with your missing health — never sit dismounted in his 2500 range.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bear Trap is your only pin and it is 11s at rank 1 — hold it for him.

edits.before: Giving away the dismount for free — mounted HP is a resource; spending it on poke instead of all-ins loses the lane.
edits.after: Heroic Swing needs a wall — all-in him in the open, or Bear Trap first, or he swings out mid-combo and pokes you for free.

notes: Both layers agreed on every chart row before this audit, so all four flips are matched pairs. Kept the existing 'R into terrain cancels his swing' line: Riot's own Heroic Swing text says he 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain', so Skaarl ramming him also ends the swing — the page's claim is supported. Akshan's W Going Rogue is camouflage, not stealth-invisibility, and its rank-5 cooldown drops to 2s; the page does not overstate it, so no edit.
